# pve_role (Data Source)

Reads a single role in Proxmox VE (`GET /access/roles/{roleid}`). Works for built-in roles (e.g. `PVEVMAdmin`) as well as roles managed by `pve_role` (resource); a nonexistent identifier fails with an error naming it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Built-in roles resolve through the same data source.
data "pve_role" "pvevmadmin" {
  roleid = "PVEVMAdmin"
}

output "pvevmadmin_privileges" {
  value = [for p in data.pve_role.pvevmadmin.privs : p]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `roleid` (String) Role identifier (PVE `pve-roleid` format), built-in or custom.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the role (same value as `roleid`).
- `privs` (Set of String) PVE privileges granted by this role (the privilege names the role index reports as granted).
